title: legacy-shop times for Portuguese stations may be one hour off: are they in Madrid or Lisbon time?

evidence.station: Porto Campanha (94xxx codes), on the Vigo-Porto line
evidence.report: a departure from Porto shown at 09:15+01:00 when the ticket says 08:15
evidence.known: the code reads every legacy-shop time as Europe/Madrid wall-clock time (legacy.MADRID)
evidence.unknown: whether Renfe's legacy shop writes Porto times in Lisbon or Madrid time; tests/fakes.py has no recorded legacy answer for a Portuguese station
